1.8 + 2 times (3)/(2) times (1)/(2) left{ (2)/(5) div ( (3)/(5) times (2)/(3) ) times (3)/(2) - 1 right}
solution:
**Given:**

1.8 + 2 times (3)/(2) times (1)/(2) left{ (2)/(5) div ( (3)/(5) times (2)/(3) ) times (3)/(2) - 1 right}

Follow the BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c5daef346e5e73abf98df5f240a698226ab6d5266af3ea7bd4599ccdc766346.png] 

**Calculation:**

1.8 + 2 times (3)/(2) times (1)/(2) left{ (2)/(5) div ( (3)/(5) times (2)/(3) ) times (3)/(2) - 1 right}

⇒1.8 + 2 × 3/2 × 1/2 { 2/5 ÷ (2/5) × 3/2 - 1}

⇒1.8 + 2 × 3/2 × 1/2 { 2/5 × 5/2 × 3/2 - 1}

⇒1.8 + 2 × 3/2 × 1/2 {3/2 - 1}

⇒1.8 + 2 × 3/2 × 1/2 × 1/2 

⇒18/10 + 3/4 

⇒9/5 + 3/4 

⇒(9 × 4 + 3 × 5)/20

⇒(36 + 15)/20

⇒51/20 

⇒ 2.55 

**∴ The required result is 2.55.**
